title: AI Tools - native preview
preview: Preview only: portable PicoClaw, Hermes Desktop AppImage, Codex CLI and Ollama bundles, Hermes Desktop system DEB, ChatGPT Desktop with Codex latest-only system DEB install, and explicit Hermes Agent official PM preparation. Full Hermes lifecycle, Ollama system/service workflows and remaining Codex Desktop operations remain Pending; the production AI plugin is unchanged.
hermes_scope: Hermes Agent source/PM preview, Linux glibc amd64/arm64. Only the reviewed v0.22.5 source commit is enabled; a newer latest release is refused until reviewed. Exact selection reuses an already completed owned preparation without downloads or PM execution. Explicit PATH enrollment copies the native bridge; detach keeps that receipt-owned copy dormant. Reenrollment reuses the verified copy. Explicit launcher refresh replaces only an already owned copy with the current native AI backend, preserving enrollment and profiles. Deactivation with --keep-preparation removes only owned PATH enrollment, the native bridge and ATM selection. The entire preparation, source, Python environments and private HOME/data stay at their existing paths; external installations and profiles are not adopted. No physical preparation/data deletion, multi-version support, data migration, frontend builds or services in this slice.
hermes_refresh: Refresh owned native Hermes launcher (preserve PATH and data)
hermes_deactivated: Hermes deactivated; entire preparation and data preserved at %s
hermes_deactivate_unchanged: Hermes already deactivated; entire preparation and data preserved
hermes_refreshed: Owned native Hermes launcher refreshed from this AI backend. PATH enrollment, profiles, selection and provider data unchanged; no provider executed.
hermes_refresh_unchanged: Owned Hermes launcher already matches this AI backend; verified no-op, executable identity preserved.
hermes_alias_usage: Enrolled command: hermes --accept-runtime-execution [--dry-run] -- [Hermes arguments]. Apps is derived from the owned executable layout; no override or implicit runtime consent. Dry-run parses only; actual launch requires valid PATH enrollment.
hermes_use: Select completed Hermes 0.22.5 (offline, no PM execution)
hermes_launch_usage: Usage: atm-ai --hermes-cli --apps-dir ABS --accept-runtime-execution [--dry-run] -- [Hermes arguments]. Exact options, explicit consent and delimiter are required; at most 128 arguments / 64 KiB.
hermes_launch_dry: Dry-run: would verify the selected reviewed Hermes preparation and launch its official CLI with private HOME under a held provider lock. No state probing, filesystem changes, network or subprocess execution performed.
hermes_launch_notice: Explicit Hermes runtime execution: private version-specific HOME/configuration, no inherited credentials. Trusted upstream runtime can change data or use the network; private HOME is not a sandbox. No PATH integration. Immediate child supervised; detached descendants are not contained.
hermes_launch_command: Official Hermes runtime command is malformed or outside the reviewed contract.
hermes_launch_cwd: Launch from a working directory outside the managed Hermes root.
hermes_launch_locked: Hermes is locked or interrupted; inspect the retained state manually
hermes_launch_retained: Hermes launch state and lock retained after interruption, changed evidence or uncertain execution; inspect manually after all children stop, no automatic recovery
hermes_launch_selected: Launch requires the selected, completed, owned reviewed Hermes 0.22.5 preparation.
hermes_launch_changed: Hermes selection changed during launch validation.
hermes_launch_start: Hermes interactive child could not start.
hermes_launch_wait: Hermes interactive child termination could not be verified.
hermes_selected: Completed Hermes 0.22.5 preparation selected. No downloads, PM execution, data migration or profile changes; runtime remains untested.
hermes_consent: Install/update requires CORE confirmation, --trust-download and --accept-dependency-execution. Exact completed selection requires CORE confirmation only, with no downloads or execution. Preparation trusts official GitHub source metadata, upstream uv and the official PM plus dependency build code. PM downloads dependencies and can execute code with your user's privileges; a private HOME is not a sandbox. Browser/computer-use optional packages are declined. No credentials are inherited. Installation may be large/slow; interrupted attempts are retained for manual inspection, not silently deleted or retried.
hermes_install: Prepare latest reviewed Hermes (execute official PM)
hermes_custom: Prepare exact reviewed Hermes (execute official PM)
hermes_update: Check/update owned Hermes (execute official PM when needed)
hermes_status: Hermes Agent: recorded attempts=%d; selected completed version=%s; runtime=unknown; PM is not executed by this view
hermes_running: Preparing private bootstrap Python and running official Hermes PM. No interactive input; wait for completion or cancel. Partial state is preserved on failure.
hermes_complete: Hermes source and PM preparation recorded complete. Existing user data/profiles were not adopted. Runtime/provider acceptance is still Pending; no agent or service was started.
hermes_unchanged: The reviewed Hermes version is already recorded complete; no dependency execution or repair performed. Runtime remains untested.
ollama_scope: Portable Ollama base bundle, with optional amd64 ROCm companion. Updates preserve the selected variant; --rocm opts into the companion for install/update. Same-version variant changes are refused. No downloaded scripts, provider execution, models, GPU drivers, JetPack/MLX setup, system packages or services. User PATH integration is separately confirmed; install, update and selection never edit profiles. Uninstall detaches exact owned PATH integration before removing versions. Manually close/stop processes using this owned bundle before updating, switching or removing versions; ATM neither probes nor stops them. Runtime and GPU compatibility are untested; existing services and external installations remain untouched.
ollama_install_rocm: Install latest base + ROCm companion (amd64; hardware compatibility unknown)
ollama_update_rocm: Update with ROCm companion (amd64; hardware compatibility unknown)
ollama_usage: Optional manual commands (not run by ATM): %s serve; in another terminal: %s run llama3; or download a model explicitly: %s pull llama3. Review existing servers and upstream configuration first; ATM does not inspect settings or probe servers. Run/pull may download models and change user data separately from ATM installation.
ollama_status: Ollama portable: verified owned versions=%d; active=%s; runtime=unknown; service/GPU/model state not queried
ollama_selected: Selected owned Ollama %s; complete bin/ollama and lib/ollama tree retained. No provider executed or profile changed.
ollama_removed: Removed owned Ollama %s; external installs, models and settings retained.

discovery_summary: %s: discovery checked=%d; missing=%d (bounded search, not proof of absence)
discovery_limits: Discovery limits: truncated=%t; skipped unsafe, relative, empty or current-directory roots=%d. Unsearched locations remain unknown.

discovery_native-preview-alias: native-preview alias excluded from external candidates; no ownership inferred

discovery_codex_desktop: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: the separate codex-desktop-system view reads bounded native dpkg package-record evidence. RPM/Arch package state remains unknown; DNF/Arch, update and removal remain Pending. Package records do not prove ATM ownership or runtime health.
codex_desktop_scope: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: latest-only system DEB install, Linux APT amd64/arm64; this is not a claim of support for every Linux derivative. Any existing chatgpt package record, including held or incomplete state, is preserved and refused. APT may install or upgrade dependencies and execute package scripts/triggers as root, affecting services and desktop integration. Custom APT preferences/paths are refused. No forced removal, adoption, app launch, sign-in or profile edits by ATM. DNF/Arch, update and removal remain Pending.
codex_desktop_consent: Requires CORE confirmation, --trust-download and --accept-system-packages. Trust is the exact official HTTPS download origin only. No upstream checksum or independent signature was discovered; locally computed SHA-256 checks byte continuity into root staging, not independent authenticity. Positive exact Content-Length and a 512 MiB bound are required; redirects are refused. Uses trusted commands via sudo -n with cached authorization: authenticate separately in a terminal when required; ATM never reads passwords. Failure/interruption may leave package-manager work running, partial installs and retained staging/locks. No automatic recovery, cleanup from journal paths or rollback is promised.
codex_desktop_install: Install latest ChatGPT Desktop with Codex (trust HTTPS download and APT side effects)
codex_desktop_guard: Initial-only installation uses a root-staged, locally hash-checked copy of the native ATM backend. APT invokes fixed native guards through its internal /bin/sh hook mechanism, not an upstream installer or Bash fallback. The early guard runs before preconfiguration; the final guard validates the exact package plan. Both require the real frontend write lock owned by a verified root APT ancestor and fresh transaction acknowledgements. Existing Pre-Invoke hooks, redirected databases/roots, incompatible dpkg options, disabled locking, and missing/nonempty dpkg updates directories are refused. Stock Pre-Install-Pkgs hooks are retained. A trusted env -i wrapper sets HOME=/ and the fixed command environment after sudo; no inherited HOME or APT_CONFIG is trusted.
codex_desktop_unknown: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: dpkg package-record state=unknown; install refused; no ownership/runtime verified: %v
codex_desktop_observed: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: observed chatgpt package record; status=%q; version=%q; architecture=%q; not ATM ownership or runtime verification. Existing state preserved; installation refused.
codex_desktop_absent: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: no chatgpt record observed in the bounded dpkg status database; not proof that all manual/RPM/Arch installations are absent. Runtime and ownership unknown.
codex_desktop_journal_unknown: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: journal unknown/interrupted; inspect manually, no replay cleanup: %v
codex_desktop_journal: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: recorded operation phase=%s; last phase=%s; version=%s; length=%d; locally computed SHA-256=%s (continuity only). Journal paths never authorize recovery or cleanup; runtime/ownership unverified.
codex_desktop_complete: ChatGPT Desktop with Codex: APT completed and the exact chatgpt version/architecture/installed-state package record was observed. This is not ATM ownership or runtime verification. No application launch, sign-in, profile edits or adoption of existing apps/data by ATM; package scripts ran under the accepted system-package policy.
system_scope: System DEB install only, Linux amd64. APT may install or upgrade Hermes Desktop and dependencies and execute package scripts/triggers as root, which may affect services and desktop integration. Administrator configuration is not rewritten. Nonempty preferences or custom preference paths are refused because local DEB installs can bypass pins. No removal, forced downgrade or ownership adoption.
system_consent: Requires CORE confirmation plus --trust-download and --accept-system-packages. The download trusts fathah/hermes-desktop GitHub HTTPS release metadata and its SHA-256, not an independent signature. Uses trusted literal commands via sudo -n; authenticate separately in a terminal if policy requires it. ATM never reads passwords. This offline menu does not resolve releases, query packages or verify sudo access.
system_install: Install latest system DEB (trust download and APT side effects)
system_custom: Install exact system DEB (trust download and APT side effects)
system_no_journal: Hermes Desktop system: no ATM operation journal; installed package state is not queried by this view.
system_journal: Hermes Desktop system: recorded operation only, not live package status
system_complete: Hermes Desktop system package verified installed. Package-manager ownership retained; application not launched. User settings and portable installations were not adopted.
uninstall: Remove all owned preview versions (keep user data)
path_integrate: Enable owned CLI in user PATH
path_scope: Explicit PATH integration prepends the owned command directory in .profile, .bashrc and existing .zshrc under the default user HOME. This can shadow existing external commands without replacing their files. CORE confirmation is required; reload the shell separately. Install, update and version selection do not edit profiles.
path_none: No selected owned PicoClaw, Codex CLI or Ollama previews; PATH unchanged.
path_enabled: Owned CLI PATH integration enabled in user profiles. Reload the shell separately; no provider was executed.
path_removed: Exact owned CLI PATH integration detached; unrelated profile content and provider versions retained.
path_recorded: owned PATH integration recorded; current shell and runtime not tested
trust: Download consent trusts the named upstream executable and its GitHub release SHA-256 metadata. This is not an independent signature. Portable downloads do not run the executable, install dependencies, edit profiles or configure services. PATH integration is a separate explicitly confirmed action.
appimage: AppImage runtime dependencies (including compatible FUSE when required) must be installed separately. ATM does not execute or extract the AppImage runtime.
preserved: Manual and legacy installations, models, credentials and settings are not adopted or removed. Only exact owned PATH blocks are changed by explicit integration or detached during uninstall; unrelated profile content is preserved. Portable versions come from private preview receipts; ChatGPT Desktop system versions are observed dpkg package records, not ownership/runtime verification.
